title: Federal Reserve Board - FOMC issues addendum to the Policy Normalization Principles and Plans
主要内容: On June 14, 2017, the Federal Reserve Board's FOMC issued an addendum to the Policy Normalization Principles and Plans. The update outlines the FOM, C's approach to reducing the Federal Reserve's holdings of Treasury and agency securities once normalization of the federal funds rate is well under way. The Committee plans to gradually reduce securities holdings by decreasing reinvestment of principal payments received from securities held in the System Open Market Account, reinvesting only to the extent that payments exceed gradually rising caps. Initially, the cap for Treasury securities will be $6 billion per month, increasing by $6 billion every three months until reaching $30 billion. For agency debt and mortgage-backed securities, the cap starts at $4 billion per month, rising by $4 billion every three months to $20 billion. The Fed aims to maintain these caps until its securities holdings decline predictably, aligning with its monetary policy goals. The reduction in securities will lead to a lower supply of reserve balances, with the Fed targeting a level below recent years but above pre-crisis levels, reflecting banking system demand and future policy efficiency.
